name: hob agent workspace OG social card by hob
description: A disciplined two-zone composition at 1200×630: a centered three-line headline in a heavy white grotesque occupies the top half on near-black, while a cropped dark app window rises from the bottom edge and provides the product proof. All colour weight is deliberately withheld — the canvas is black/white/gray until the small circular white badge with a teal-to-orange bar mark, which does double duty as wordmark and focal accent. The window is rendered as atmosphere (low-contrast UI chrome, readable diff colours but illegible body text) so the headline and badge stay the only fully legible elements even at feed thumbnail size.
